sourceAnomalies.finding: Background duplicates point_mc as Mc_101 etc. disableMC/enableMC instead address point_mc101 etc.; hide/remove use Mc_101. Preserve the mismatch; this audit does not repair it.

Wrong Close enables fixed points, then hideMovieClip hides PT_1..PT_5 and all dynamic points. enableMC does not restore visibility or gotoAndStop(1); source contains no retry reinitialization at frame208. Any successful second-attempt UX requires an explicit later source-disposition decision.
rmMovieClip removes GLine_Mc only inside i101..mcCount. With mcCount100 the loop does not execute; hideMovieClip still hides the line. The source counter is not reset on wrong close.

PT_1 always writes Y; PT_2..PT_5 always write C. Clicking multiple nonintercept fixed points while Y is empty replaces C and disables each selected sprite. Background assigns the first empty Y slot, otherwise C. Source does not simply append arbitrary selected points.

Draw Line uses indexOf on PT_2,PT_3,PT_4,PT_5, not a set or geometric equation. Y==PT_1 with accepted C is rewritten to Y=PT_3,C=PT_5 before drawing. Other nonempty Y/C strings use the same substring conditions. Do not silently substitute generalized mathematical correctness.

Coach button calls Mc_Popup1.Mc_Ani.Mc_Ani1/2.gotoAndPlay(2); coach570 has one frame and no named children, and these names do not appear in any static timeline. No local attach/load creates them. Original host behavior remains unverified.
Quiz setup hides Mc_Popup2 and Mc_txt1, neither present in the static timeline. Retain source references without inventing UI.
point_mc is sprite549 with exactly one frame, while its clip release calls gotoAndStop(2). AVM1/original host treatment is unverified.

Mc_Right_Feed1 is placed twice (170/228), Mc_Right_Feed2 twice (131/463); all nine feedback sprites are stopped at frame1 and none is selected by Draw Line. No random or multiple-choice feedback is inferred.

Coach_audio_1/2 are main children529/531 stopped at frame1; the help button references missing Mc_Ani children instead. Terminal scripts call undefined-local enableButton; no playable help narration is established.

Unplaced sprites5/7 export roundHandle/squareHandle and contain drag bounds. They are not statically reachable from root; duplicate ExportAssets named need (14/15/15) are retained. Do not turn this page into draggable fixed points merely from these library actions.
Text578 concatenates 1 and 3 to 13; its source glyph baselines and shape579 form a fraction. Preserve source runs/matrix/path instead of literal thirteen.
